description: Find the most auspicious upcoming dates for an activity using panchang rules (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, weekday, Panchak, Tara Bala). Activities: marriage, griha-pravesh, business, vehicle, travel, education, namkaran, property.

activity.description: The activity to find dates for.

days.description: How many days to scan. Defaults to 90.

from.description: First date to consider, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place, decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees.

top.description: How many dates to return. Defaults to 10.

name: find_muhurat
title: Find auspicious dates (muhurat)
